title: MI: Yappadium
description: A Modern Industrialization based Modpack with alot of Performance upgrades!
body:
A Modern Industrialization based Modpack with alot of Performance upgrades!
If you have seen Yappadium itself you know it is a good performance modpack, I used Yappadium for the base of this modpack.

Mods included:
- Modern Industrialization, and Addons!
  
Important message:

Do not Update Nvidium (Neoforge) and JEI, this will crash you're game.

Only updating this modpack when Modern Industrialization is updated to newer versions of Minecraft OR MI itself!
